lanes.name: Readings
lanes.outcome: Every account's subscription windows are read accurately from each vendor: window length, fraction used, reset, hold and plan. Not: what a reading means or where it is heading (Forecasts), or how it is shown (Display).
lanes.ms: Every subscription a person holds, on any vendor, read reliably and fresh.

lanes.name: Forecasts
lanes.outcome: A person or agent knows where each window is heading and whether it runs out before it resets. Not: choosing which candidate to use (Choosing), or reading the raw figures (Readings).
lanes.ms: Forecasts trustworthy enough to pace work by.

lanes.name: Catalog
lanes.outcome: A caller can look up which vendors offer which models, on which plans, at what quota price and with what published figures. Not: ranking them for a task (Choosing).
lanes.ms: One current, sourced catalog of vendors, models and offerings.

lanes.name: Choosing
lanes.outcome: A caller asks which candidate is best for a task under its own constraints and gets a full, explained order, with every choice and attempt recorded as asked and as it came out. Not: holding any caller's policy or scenario, which stays with the caller.
lanes.ms: A domain-agnostic load balancer that learns from recorded outcomes.

lanes.name: Display
lanes.outcome: A person sees at a glance, in the menu bar or terminal, how much of each window is used and whether to spend or save it. Not: the JSON contract agents consume (Readings, Forecasts).
lanes.ms: Usage legible in one glance, without opening anything.
